first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A dark-colored short handgun in the lower-right foreground from a first-person perspective, with a bluish-green cast on the gun body and a nearly rectangular slide.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A tall, slender, upright humanoid fictional creature to the left of the canister group, with a predominantly tan-brown head and long arms, predominantly gray sides of the torso and legs, and slender claw tips.

entities.name: group of light-colored small crab-shaped creatures
entities.identification: Two low, small creatures on the floor in front of the horizontal bar, with light yellowish-brown, rounded, bulging bodies and darker brown limbs extending outward.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: Gray to bluish-gray paneled walls enclosing the passageway, with rectangular panel seams and rows of rivets visible in the clear areas.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: Gray to grayish-brown metal floor panels in the passageway, with a repeating grid-like texture on the surface.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: A dark-colored panel-like ceiling above the passageway, connected around its edges to multiple parallel trim strips.

entities.name: hatch guardrail
entities.identification: Dark-colored angled metal bars on both sides of the foreground hatch, with straight edges.

entities.name: group of tall white canisters
entities.identification: Four tall grayish-white canisters standing upright side by side at the end of the passageway, narrowing at the top and with dark-colored short necks.

entities.name: hazardous horizontal bar
entities.identification: A dark-colored barrier positioned horizontally in front of the canister group, with light-colored DANGER lettering inside a red rectangular sign at the center.

entities.name: explosion fireball
entities.identification: A bright white-yellow irregular mass of fire appearing in the canister-group area, with yellow-orange around the outside.

entities.name: gray fragments
entities.identification: Panels and sharp-cornered fragments of varying sizes scattered after the blast, appearing gray-white or bluish-green when illuminated.

entities.name: yellow stain
entities.identification: Light-yellow irregular patches and splatter marks on the passageway floor and along the base of the right wall after the explosion.

entities.name: indoor light fixture
entities.identification: A rectangular light fixture on the ceiling, with a dark-colored outer frame and a bright luminous surface.

entities.name: hatch flange
entities.identification: The thick metal edge around the foreground opening, locally forming a corner and showing a bluish-green illuminated surface.
